title: Stelle, per carità, Signor Alfonso
subtitle: Fiordiligi, Dorabella and Don Alfonso: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 3, recitative after No. 5
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Signor, Oh Dei, Che caso dunque?, Nè un solo addio).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 34–36, the recitative between No. 5 and No. 6 (23 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Playback tempo ♩ = 99, a nominal speaking pace for secco recitative, from Böhm's recording (0:56); Mozart gives no tempo.

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
